literal_meaning: শেওড়া গাছের পেত্নী (sheora tree's female ghost)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটাই কুৎসিত যে শেওড়াগাছের পেত্নীর মতো দেখায়।
তার চেহারা দেখলে মনে হয় শেওড়াগাছের পেত্নী নেমে এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: She is so ugly that she looks like the witch of the sheora tree.
Her appearance makes one think the ghost of the sheora tree has descended.
history: In Bengali folklore, sheora trees (Ziziphus mauritiana) are often associated with hauntings by petni or female spirits, believed to lure and harm people, especially in rural areas.
note: This idiom draws from rural superstitions where certain trees are considered eerie and inhabited by ghosts.
